message: Your argument about funding is a bit disingenuous, given that your 'safe and accessible' model has its own challenges. Meanwhile, your position on paternalism is questionable – you're essentially saying that women can't be trusted to make their own decisions. Let's focus on the real issues at hand.

runs.justification: The message uses 'disingenuous' and 'questionable' to attack Persona 2's character and motives, rather than engaging with their argument about funding. It also resorts to caricature by saying Persona 2 believes 'women can't be trusted to make their own decisions'.
